30.name: Hoopers Sandy Beach Guest Rooms (1)
30.overview: The ultimate B&B battle is back. Paul hosts the week's first visit at his seafront B&B in Swansea, where he's hoping stunning views and a watercolour masterclass will sail him to victory.

30.name: Cae Court Hotel (2)
30.overview: Steve and Andrew host the week's second visit at Cae Court Hotel in Bridgend, where the B&Bers raise a tostada to a brilliant Spanish brekkie

30.name: Silver Fern Glamping (3)
30.overview: The B&Bers visit Shaun and Sarah's glampsite in Aberystwyth, where a pair of resident diddy donkeys steal the show - and plenty of hearts

30.name: Northop Hall Country House Hotel (4)
30.overview: The week's final visit is to Fritha and Justin's country hotel in Flintshire, where things get frosty over al fresco drinks, and breakfast is chaotic

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: It's payment day following a wonderful week in Wales. The problem is, none of the B&Bers can agree on what exactly was wonderful about it.

30.name: Norfolk: Three Horseshoes (1)
30.overview: Fiona and Michael kick off the competition at their homely country pub in Norfolk. But a problem with a shower makes a guest feel dour.

30.name: The Red House (2)
30.overview: Carl and Liz host the week’s second visit at their coaching inn in Cambridgeshire, where converted stables and Highland cows are on the menu (not literally)

30.name: Holly Lodge Boutique B&B (3)
30.overview: Can an old-school Wurlitzer organ make the guests forget their grout doubts at Barbara and Elizabeth's boutique B&B in Norfolk?

30.name: Peacock Lake (4)
30.overview: The week’s final hosts, Helen and Carl, have their work cut out to impress at their Nottinghamshire glampsite after ruffling feathers with their feedback all week

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: Cleanliness has been the buzz word this week, with pretty much all of the hosts unhappy about their less-than sparkling scores. Have some of them been playing dirty?

30.name: The Courtyard (1)
30.overview: This week's competition begins at cosy pub the Courtyard in Falkirk, where guests pay a visit to the Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift.

30.name: Finn Village (2)
30.overview: The rivals arrive at Finn Village, Cliff and Monika's countryside place near Loch Lomond. A tranquil boat trip on the loch should help the hoteliers relax - but relations start getting choppy out on the water.

30.name: Domes by the Sea (3)
30.overview: Brothers John and Andrew host the week's third visit at the glampsite on their family farm in Dumfries and Galloway, where things get heated with saunas and hot tubs.

30.name: Brooklands Guest House (4)
30.overview: Sue hosts the week's final visit at her Victorian townhouse B&B in Penrith, where a marmalade tasting is followed by some bittersweet discussion of payment day.

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: On payment day, a number of B&Bers are certain their competitors have been doing some tit-for-tat marking. When the dust settles, who'll win the week?

30.name: Hotel Penzance (1)
30.overview: Louise and Daga offer breathtaking views at their place in Cornwall. But forget what's out the window - the B&Bers are preoccupied with their tellies.

30.name: The Horn of Plenty (2)
30.overview: Visit two takes the B&Bers to twin sisters Sara and Paula's hotel in Devon. After an afternoon on the lash at a local vineyard, are there sour grapes in the feedback?

30.name: Angove Guest House (3)
30.overview: Delightful décor, sumptuous sausages and proper milk await the B&Bers at Simon and Vanessa's coastal guesthouse in Weymouth.

30.name: The Drayton Crown (4)
30.overview: The week's final visit is to Jordan and Robin's pub in Somerset. But with one B&Ber dreading the potential of stale ale smell, the hosts have their work cut out.

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: It's payment day: a chance for the B&Bers to complain about specks of dust that they've somehow found after trawling their rooms with a high-powered magnifying glass.

30.name: Wonderland Retreats Luxury Glamping (1)
30.overview: Shauna and Sam's Lancashire glampsite boasts a wealth of top-end facilities, including hot tubs, cinema screens and pizza ovens. Is it enough to see them victorious?

30.name: Optimal Apartments (2)
30.overview: At luxury self-catering digs in Bradford, the B&Bers aren't sure that flat-pack furniture quite equates to the promised opulence.

30.name: Impossible Motel, York (3)
30.overview: At a quirky hotel in York that features a dungeon room full of chains, the B&Bers indulge in some BDSM: bellyaching, disagreeing, stain-hunting and moaning.

30.name: Beach Suites (4)
30.overview: Martial arts expert dan hosts the week's final visit in Southport, where he aims to please with his no-nonsense approach to a classic seaside getaway.

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: Allegations of game playing are rife on payment day, with one pair vastly underpaying everyone. You could cut the tension with a best-value-B&B plaque!

30.name: The Crown Inn (1)
30.overview: The B&Bers visit an old pub in Kent and do some drag bingo.

30.name: Kits Coty Glamping (2)
30.overview: Alarm bells ring for one pair in their bell tent at a plush glampsite in Kent.

30.name: Stone Court House (3)
30.overview: Saban hosts at his 700-year-old house in Maidstone, where the magnificent historic vibes aren't enough to stop evening drinks turning terrifically tense.

30.name: Old Town House (4)
30.overview: Mark and Anne host at their Margate townhouse, where the atmosphere turns icy over ice cream at the beach thanks to one guest who just can't forget about his own feedback.

30.name: Payment Day (5)
30.overview: After a feisty week in Kent - when some B&Bers couldn't even wait until payment day to get their gripes off their chest - it is now actually payment day.

31.name: Rosemay Hotel
31.overview: The competition kicks off in Hayes, where Asmi and Yousef host at their historic hotel with a famous literary connection

31.name: Piggles Retreat
31.overview: Mum and daughter Trisha and Lucy host at their Cambridgeshire glampsite, where an extra jaunt to get to the loos proves too much for one set of guests to handle.

31.name: The Great House
31.overview: Onur and Yann host at their historic, opulent hotel in Suffolk but one set of guests think that a broken coffee machine doesn’t add up to luxury.

31.name: Hank's Ranch
31.overview: The B&Bers don their cowboy boots for a proper, authentic, no-detail-spared visit to the Wild West at Hank’s Ranch. In, er, Norfolk.

31.name: Payment Day
31.overview: A picky week culminates in a payment day packed with facilities failings fracas and allegations of tit-for-tat marking. Who’s won it all?

31.name: Horse and Groom Inn
31.overview: In Oxfordshire, Ru and Alex's recently refurbished inn doesn't immediately hit all the right notes. Can an afternoon of boozing at a brewery get them back on track?

31.name: Four Bells Glamping
31.overview: Alex and Lucy host at their Suffolk glampsite. Their luxurious bell tents offer extensive creature comforts but that's not enough for some of their guests...

31.name: Bredon View Glamping
31.overview: The B&Bers go glamping for a second time, at Jo and Dan's plush site in Worcestershire, where a stain stains things for one pair.

31.name: The Manor at Bickley
31.overview: On the final visit of the week, Graham and Vee encourage their guests to lord it up at their elegant manor in Bromley

31.name: Payment Day
31.overview: It's been a week of divisive digs and bothersome DIY breakfasts. What better way to sort it all out than a good old-fashioned sit down on payment day?

31.name: The Nelthorpe Arms
31.overview: The competition kicks off at Vicky and Anne-Marie's historic pub in Lincolnshire. Will their traditional inn pull in plenty of praise?

31.name: Escape Town
31.overview: Violet and Pati host at their ultra-modern self-catering apartments in Boston, where the so-called 'smart loos' perhaps aren't that clever.

31.name: Maes Y Neuadd
31.overview: First impressions at Harvey and Roisin's manor hotel in Gwynedd are flawless, until one B&Ber ends up wishing they'd looked at the floor less.

31.name: 3Trees Glamping
31.overview: A spider sighting sends some guests scurrying at Sarah and Paul's Derbyshire glampsite. Is the additional cleaning fee even scarier?

31.name: Payment Day
31.overview: Bathroom bothers are at the top of the agenda on payment day, with discussions about uneven floors and some very divisive smart loos just waiting to cause chaos.

31.name: Fairy River
31.overview: Conor and Claire aim to give their guests a magical, mythical experience in Northern Ireland's beautiful Mourne Mountains.

31.name: Wilton House
31.overview: Melissa wants to provide all-things luxury at her apartments in Belfast city centre but the B&Bers' eagle eyes cause cleanliness consternation.

31.name: Dufferin Coaching Inn
31.overview: The character is cracking at Janine and Corah-Jaye's historic coaching inn in County Down but the style proves contentious.

31.name: Willowbank House
31.overview: Shaun and Aiofe host the week's final visit at their family home in County Fermanagh. Will Shaun's culinary boasts come back to haunt him?

31.name: Payment Day
31.overview: There's plenty on the agenda on payment day in Northern Ireland, from cleanliness critiques to...more cleanliness critiques.

31.name: Stover Lodge
31.overview: Estelle and Steve welcome their rivals to their guest house in Torquay, where Steve's culinary credentials leave the B&Bers hungry for some haute cuisine.

31.name: The Sheep and Penguin
31.overview: Jan and Deb look to dazzle the B&Bers at their Somerset pub, where the group hit all kinds of highs with a unique singing lesson.

31.name: The Star
31.overview: In Pembrokeshire, the décor dazzles at Donna and Mike's micro pub. Some shoddy sleep scores leave the hosts feeling deflated.

31.name: The Blue Lion
31.overview: The B&Bers are boozing it up at yet another pub, this time at Henry and Lucy's place in North Wales, where the gloves are very much off...

31.name: Payment Day
31.overview: A jaw-dropping payment is the talk of the town on payment day, prompting some rather heated debate.
